lessons.title: Aggregate split invoices
lessons.rule: Invoices from the same supplier for the same job within 60 days are added together before applying the ₹1 lakh no-PO limit.
lessons.trigger: No-PO invoice where the same supplier billed related work recently, or the invoice mentions a phase or part
lessons.action_required: Escalate on the aggregate amount; one PO for the whole job.

lessons.title: Bank changes by callback only
lessons.rule: Any new or changed bank details on an invoice or email are verified by a phone call to the number on the supplier master before paying.
lessons.trigger: Invoice or request mentions new, changed or updated bank details
lessons.action_required: Hold & ask: callback verification before payment.

lessons.title: No 'use it or lose it' spend
lessons.rule: Spend justified by the budget lapsing needs a business case showing use in the next quarter.
lessons.trigger: Overrun or purchase justified by year-end, budget lapse, or using up budget
lessons.action_required: Ask for the use plan before approving.

lessons.title: No advances to distressed suppliers
lessons.rule: If a supplier signals cash trouble (delayed salaries, cash crunch, client not paying), no advance regardless of percentage.
lessons.trigger: Advance or early payment where the supplier mentions cash flow difficulty
lessons.action_required: Escalate; offer pay-in-arrears or milestone payment instead.
